negative_reviews.author: Alice Haffar
negative_reviews.text: Came at 16:10 on a Friday. Says online and in the window they are open but in fact they’re NOT! I saw the whole team of employees having a meeting and when I called, someone came to the daughter to tell me that the kitchen is closed. Misinformation. I work nearby and was unable to have lunch because of the false information. They’ve been open for a new months now so this mistake should’ve been addressed. Another couple outside with me came specifically to each here bc of the times shown online and had to find another place after travelling.

negative_reviews.author: Ollie P
negative_reviews.text: Don't try to order on Deliveroo! Waited nearly an hour and a half after the expected 15-25 minute delivery time. Had to cancel, left very hungry

negative_reviews.author: P “Joop”
negative_reviews.text: Disappointed. The vegan katsu curry was definitely made with bland quorn fillets. And the pink lighting made it hard to read the menu.  Generally was so so, wouldn't rush back
